title: AdverSim: Validated LLM-Generated Cyber-Range Scenarios with MITRE ATT&CK Grounding
description: AdverSim is a reproducible Python research codebase for generating, validating, mutating, and evaluating MITRE ATT&CK-aligned adversarial cyber-range scenarios. The repository contains the reproducible code and lightweight fixtures; large generated corpora and manuscript artifacts are kept outside git.
